final: WITH m AS (SELECT e.ordersmark AS ref, o.timespan AS tif, e.fillcount AS fc FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), g AS (SELECT ref, tif, AVG(fc) AS gavg FROM m GROUP BY ref, tif), t AS (SELECT tif, AVG(gavg) AS tavg FROM g GROUP BY tif), j AS (SELECT g.ref, g.tif, g.gavg, g.gavg - t.tavg AS diff FROM g JOIN t ON t.tif = g.tif WHERE g.gavg > t.tavg), r AS (SELECT ref, tif, gavg, diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tif ORDER BY gavg DESC) AS rk FROM j) SELECT ref, tif, gavg, diff, rk FROM r WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY tif, rk
